title: GaLore optimizer state with reusable Mirror subspace codes
hypothesis: When independent tasks repeatedly use a small number of left-gradient subspaces, a shared projector dictionary and per-task Mirror codes reduce serialized GaLore resume state while retaining the convergence and retention of task-specific GaLore projectors.
physical_object: Per-task trainable 32x32 matrices and low-rank Adam moments
mirror_coordinate: Per-task discrete code selecting one projector from a shared gradient-subspace dictionary
logical_multiplicity: 16 task-specific optimizer geometries over 1/2/4/8 recurring gradient modes

task.metric: Mean/worst held-out task MSE after sequential training, actual inference bytes, actual resumable optimizer checkpoint bytes
task.projector_discovery: Each task's initial full gradient; Mirror/native dictionary built from one calibration gradient per recurring mode; all costs reported

controls: Independent full Adam matrix per task
Standard GaLore with independently stored rank-4 projector and low-rank Adam moments per task
Mirror codebook GaLore with a shared projector dictionary and per-task codes
Native shared projector dictionary with ordinary discrete projector IDs, using the identical decoder

storage.authority: actual serialized inference payload bytes and resumable optimizer checkpoint bytes
storage.datasets_excluded: Training inputs/targets are deterministic task data and are not resumable optimizer state; their generation seed and provenance are recorded.

compute: projector discovery SVD count and wall time
success_gate: On both development seeds for K=1/2/4/8, Mirror held-out MSE <= 1.10x standard GaLore, previous-task retention degradation <=0.01, complete resumable payload <=95% of standard GaLore at K<=4 and serialized projector dictionary plus codes <=50% of independently stored projector bytes at K<=4, and strict Mirror-specific improvement over native dictionary IDs in at least one preregistered metric.
failure_gate: Mirror misses quality/resume-byte gate or exactly aliases native projector-ID control without strict Mirror-specific gain. Keep fresh seeds sealed on failure.
boundaries: No language-model training or natural gradient-statistics claim
Task matrices are independent; this tests saved optimizer geometry, not multi-task inference capacity
Report inference and resume bytes separately
